1. This Act may be cited as the International Monetary short title,
Fund (Ratification of Second Amendment to the Articles
of Agreement) Act 1977.

2. In this Act—                                     Inter-
pretation.
"International Monetary Fund" (hereinafter referred to
as the "Fund") means the International Monetary Fund of
which Malaysia is a member by virtue of section 3 of the
Bretton Woods Agreements Ordinance 1957;              75157,

"Articles of Agreement" means the Articles of Agreement
of the said Fund as amended pursuant to Resolution No.
31-4 adopted by the Board of Governors of the Fund on
April 30, 1976;

"Special Drawing Rights Department" means the Account
through which the Fund will conduct all operations and
transactions involving Special Drawing Rights allocated

"General Department" means the Account through which
the Fund will conduct all other operations and transactions
authorised by the Articles of Agreemenit;

"General Resources Account" means the Account of the
Genetal Department through which the Fund will conduct
all its operations and transactions using the general resources
of the Fund;

"Special Disbursement Account" means the Account of
the General Department in which profits from the sale of
the Fund's gold shall be held for use in accordance with
the provisions governing that Account in section 12 of
Article V and Schedule B to the Articles of Agreement;

"Investment Account" means the Account of the General
Department established under section 6 (f) (i) of Article XII
of the Articles of Agreement, in which the Fund's resources
used for and resulting from investment will be held.

3. The Yang di-Pertuan Agong may by instrument under
his hand empower such person as he may name in such
instrument—

(a) to accept on behalf of Malaysia the Second Amend-

ment to the Articles of Agreement of the Fund

- annexed to the March 1976 Report by the Executive

a to the Board of Governors of the Fund;

accordance with the laws of Malaysia, undertakes
all the obligations of a member of the Fund under
the Second Amendment of the Articles of Agreement
of the Fund and that the Government has taken all
steps necessary to enable it to carry out all of these
obligations.
